passage.label: indeed tried them tried companions garden swore cut fruit morning without exception; came upon garden affliction Lord while asleep became though reaped; called one another morning; saying go early crop would cut fruit; set out lowering voices; saying surely not enter today upon poor person; went early determination assuming able; saw said indeed lost; rather deprived; most moderate said did not say why not exalt Allah; said Exalted Lord indeed wrongdoers; approached one another blaming; said O woe us indeed transgressors; perhaps Lord substitute better indeed toward Lord desirous; such punishment world punishment Hereafter greater only knew

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينٞ
قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ

mainSubject.label: Trial paralleled to the garden-companions who swore to harvest at dawn without exception, so an affliction from their Lord struck while they slept leaving it as though reaped; calling each other at dawn to harvest before any poor person enters, setting out determined yet whispering, only to find it destroyed and admit loss and deprivation; the most moderate reminding them of his counsel to exalt Allah, prompting collective glorification, confession of wrongdoing, mutual blame and hope for a better replacement since they desire their Lord; this named worldly punishment with the Hereafter's being greater if they knew

subordinateSubjects.label: Trial paralleled to the garden-companions who swore to harvest at dawn
They swore without making any exception for divine will
An affliction from their Lord struck the garden while they slept
It became as though reaped by morning
They called one another at dawn
Urging each other to go early to cut the fruit
Setting out while lowering their voices
Declaring no poor person would enter upon them that day
Going early in determination, assuming themselves able
Seeing it destroyed, they admitted they were lost
Rather, they confessed they had been deprived
The most moderate reminded them of his counsel to exalt Allah
They glorified their Lord and confessed wrongdoing
Approaching one another in mutual blame
Hoping their Lord would substitute something better since they desire Him
This named worldly punishment with the Hereafter's being greater if they knew

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Did I not say to you: Why do you not exalt Allah?

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers.

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the snout-branding verdict (16) before the garden-companions parable opens (17); P2 ends with the worldly-versus-hereafter punishment comparison (33) before the righteous-gardens and rhetorical challenges begin (34); P3 runs through the criminal-equation challenge, the shin-uncovering scene and the progressive-leading declaration (34-47); P4 covers Yunus's patience lesson, the evil-eye threat and the closing reminder-to-the-worlds declaration (48-52).
